## Context / immutable basis
Exactly 58 bloated prose blocks are confirmed in 13 paths under tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/mutate/. Condense redundant or historical text while retaining current non-obvious contracts.

Inventory and before-citations are pinned to origin/main@d6669496cae441fc8381b5ee6de21a3993defd84. All impacted blobs match the clean audit worktree at 10533b1e3f651a60e8cea5691318c108ff1f3396. Implement from current origin/main; keep d6669496cae441fc8381b5ee6de21a3993defd84 as the immutable before side. The leaf is one commit (HEAD^..HEAD).

## Boundary and guards
Edit only the anchored ordinary comments/docstrings below and adjacent blank lines. Currentize RED, pre-fix, “Today”, and implementation-scaffolding prose. Executable statements, assertions, runtime strings, directives, and unlisted prose stay unchanged.

Parse base/final files with ast.parse(source, type_comments=True); strip only leading Expr(Constant(str)) nodes from Module/ClassDef/FunctionDef/AsyncFunctionDef bodies; normalize only ast.TypeIgnore.lineno; require exact ast.dump(..., include_attributes=False) equality. Tokenizer comparison preserves exact directive text/attachment; runtime strings remain AST-identical.

## Scope — 58 editable blocks
- test_parent_divergence_alert_39c1.py (7) — module; docstrings test_{unrepresentable_parent_writes_a_bridge_alert,unrepresentable_parent_is_still_non_fatal,hierarchy_rejection_alerts_under_a_distinct_kind,a_successful_parent_set_writes_no_alert,a_broken_alert_store_does_not_break_the_pass}; comment beginning “A summary rides along”. Preserve distinct durable alert kinds, transport evidence, non-fatal delivery, and sink-failure behavior.
- test_payload_shadow_corpus.py (1) — module. Preserve the versioned match/reject corpus and side-effect-free typed/legacy comparison.
- test_payload_shadow_effect_spies.py (5) — module, _boom_unless_git, effect_spies, test_spies_actually_fire_on_a_leaky_stub, test_effect_spies_do_not_leak_socket_connect_into_later_tests. Preserve every effect tripwire, git-isolation pass-through, socket-patch teardown, and nested pytest ordering regression.
- test_payload_shadow_route_census.py (1) — module. Preserve the typed-payload import allowlist and prohibition on production shadow routing.
- test_rebar_id_label_writers.py (10) — module; test_{apply_raises_for_unauthorized_rebar_id_label_mutation,guard_mode_precedence,outbound_create_may_write_rebar_id_label,inbound_repair_property_must_not_write_rebar_id_label,outbound_create_attempting_delete_action_raises}; comments beginning “Simple mock objects”, “apply() selects typed dispatch”, “Per-leaf test matrix”, and “NOTE: inbound_repair_property”. Preserve canonical Mutation identity, env-over-config precedence, the leaf/action matrix, and property-vs-label boundary. Decorative test banners are excluded.
- test_reconciler_coordinator_taxonomy.py (6) — module, _RecordingCreateClient, and test_{s7_create_route_creates_before_label_and_never_deletes,s8_replay_safety_forbids_replay_after_ambiguous_commit,s8_transition_replay_resume_skips_already_applied_hops,s10_observability_sink_failure_never_costs_delivery}. Preserve create ordering, observe-before-replay, resume, and delivery-over-observability contracts.
- test_reconciler_coordinator.py (5) — module and test_{s1_venue_parity_cloud_and_dc_applied_cutover,s3_long_delay_deferral_endpoint_fuse_with_retry_not_before,s4_permanent_failure_not_masked_under_open_scope,s5_provider_scope_fuse_isolates_and_never_conflates_independent_provider}. Preserve five-bucket parity and fuse isolation.
- test_scoped_pass_fuse.py (14) — module, _Outcome; test_{provider_requires_two_distinct_endpoints,excluded_dispositions_never_increment,neutral_outcome_does_not_break_consecutive_run,e2e_budget_exhaustion_counts_first_attempt_transient_absorbed,e2e_open_endpoint_defers_matching_but_independent_endpoint_runs,success_after_open_recloses_scope,unresolvable_binding_never_opens_or_conflates,retry_not_before_is_exact_literal,default_now_ms_is_not_epoch_zero,historical_replay_completed_slice_never_prematurely_stops,historical_replay_counterfactual_burst_would_stop}; comment beginning “RP-03 S3 T3”. Preserve thresholds, resets, scope independence, deterministic time, and replay control.
- test_t2_cloud_summary_operation_heldout.py (1) — module. Preserve one-attempt summary recovery, classification, redaction, and log bounds.
- test_update_one_field_filter.py (3) — module, test_update_one_forwards_status_to_client, test_update_one_empty_after_filter_still_calls_update_issue. State the implemented allowlist/status route and empty-update contract, not RED history.
- test_update_one_parent_routing.py (1) — module. State the implemented set_parent route and non-fatal hierarchy rejection, not RED history.
- test_update_priority_heldout_c9c6.py (3) — module, test_acli_cmd_is_still_honoured_where_a_subprocess_is_actually_spawned, test_run_acli_uses_acli_cmd_as_an_argv_prefix. Preserve REST-vs-argv separation.
- test_update_priority_target_resolution.py (1) — module. Preserve configured Jira URL/auth request evidence.

## Consumers and directives
Pytest collects every module; check_comment_hygiene.py consumes repository prose. The effect-spy socket regression itself runs the later audit-serve test in nested pytest. No targeted __doc__, inspect.getdoc, or doctest consumer was found.

Preserve exactly 9 directive tokens and their attachments: parent-divergence (1 union-attr); rebar-id writers (2 union-attr); scoped fuse (one import-bootstrap pragma, one union-attr); cloud summary (1 arg-type); update-field (1 union-attr); update-parent (1 union-attr); priority held-out (1 call-arg).

## Independent receipt
A non-author reviewer posts exactly 58 leaf-linked TSV rows:
path<TAB>anchor/kind<TAB>before-citation<TAB>after-citation<TAB>preserved-contract-or-consumer<TAB>before-words<TAB>after-words<TAB>semantic-preservation<TAB>bloat-removal<TAB>reviewer-session

Citations use full SHAs, every after count is lower, and both verdicts are PASS. Missing, duplicate, or extra rows block closure.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The TSV has exactly 58 unique rows mapping one-to-one to the 58 allowlisted blocks.
- [ ] Every TSV row has full before/after SHA citations.
- [ ] Every TSV row has `after_words < before_words`.
- [ ] Every TSV row has `bloat-removal=PASS`.
- [ ] Every TSV row has `semantic-preservation=PASS`.
- [ ] Every TSV row has `directives_exact=PASS`.
- [ ] Every `reviewer-session` names a reviewer who did not author the remediation.
- [ ] DD `semantic` exits 0.
- [ ] DD `directives` exits 0.
- [ ] DD `paths` exits 0.
- [ ] DD `diff` exits 0.
- [ ] DD `hygiene` exits 0.
- [ ] DD `focused` exits 0.
- [ ] DD `full` exits 0 without a timeout.

## Verification
Run all seven structured commands: semantic, directives, paths, diff, hygiene, focused, full.
